title: LIMIT, OFFSET, and FETCH
description: Page results with LIMIT, OFFSET, and SQL-standard FETCH.

data.title: LIMIT and OFFSET
data.code:
SELECT id, name
FROM products
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT $1 OFFSET $2;

data.title: FETCH
data.code:
SELECT id, name
FROM products
ORDER BY created_at DESC
FETCH NEXT 25 ROWS ONLY;

data.title: Cursors
data.text: For large result sets, consider DECLARE CURSOR to avoid repeated scans.

data.title: Exercise: Paginate Products
data.description: Implement page-based pagination for a product catalog.
steps: Use keyset pagination for deep pages

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Use LIMIT and OFFSET for simple pagination.
Use FETCH NEXT for SQL-standard syntax.
Avoid deep OFFSET on large tables.
